mapper.select:
SELECT distinct BOND.SEC_ID AS secId, BOND.VALUE_DATE AS valueDate, FIN.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr, BOND.LAST_PERIOD AS lastPeriod, BOND.PRICE AS price, BOND.NETPRICE AS netprice, BOND.M_DURATION AS mDuration, BOND.M_CONVEXITY AS mConvexity, BOND.BPVALUE AS bpvalue, BOND.SDURATION AS sduration, BOND.SCNVXTY AS scnvxty, BOND.INTEREST_DURATION AS interestDuration, BOND.INTEREST_CNVXTY AS interestCnvxty, BOND.VALUE_SOURCE valueSource,
BOND.BPYIELD*100 AS bpyield, BOND.CREATE_TIME importDay FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN, MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO BOND WHERE FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = BOND.SEC_ID AND BOND.SEC_ID=#{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND BOND.VALUE_DATE=STR_TO_DATE(#{valueDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND BOND.VALUE_SOURCE=#{valueSource,jdbcType=DATE}
